title: Identity normalization of the exact compactification unit
statement:
Let X be Noetherian, A a finite commutative ring, F an additive exact endofunctor of constant-A module sheaves on X, and ι:F→(idX)* an isomorphism. In the proper identity compactification let a:F≅j!⋙p* be normalized into ordinary direct image by ι, and let c have inverse δ(c,F,a). Then the chosen compact-support comparison followed by c, D(ι followed by lowerStarId), and the exact-derived identity isomorphism equals unboundedEtaleLowerShriekId.
Conventions and constructions: [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], [def-amb-etale-compact-support], [def-sfb-exact-compactification-unit], [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons].

proof.text: For every identity compactification the source open is clopen, hence its sheaf inclusion into direct image is invertible. Normalize F against these inclusions. The finite proper identity gives an invertible exact unit, and refinement compatibility transfers invertibility to every compactification. Inverting the units gives a compatible family, equal to the supplied comparison at the proper identity.

Exact-derived composition naturality and its right unit law identify the derived multiplication with the whiskered exact-derived identity comparison.

proof.text: The existing left unit law for unbounded compact support identifies its composition map. Naturality of the exact-derived isomorphism to the identity, cancellation of the invertible comparison, and faithfulness of R(id)! identify the identity comparisons. Transport from the chosen compactification to the proper identity using the refinement equation.

theorem exactCompactificationUnit_identity
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) ⥤
      Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))
    [F.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    (ι : F ⟶ lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (𝟙 X)) [IsIso ι]
    (a : F ≅
      openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
          (Compactification.ofIsProper (𝟙 X)).i ⋙
        lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (Compactification.ofIsProper (𝟙 X)).g)
    (na : a.hom ≫ compactificationSheafToDirectImage.{u} A
      (Compactification.ofIsProper (𝟙 X)) = ι)
    (c : rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
      (Compactification.ofIsProper (𝟙 X)) ≅ F.mapDerivedCategory)
    (uc : c.inv = exactCompactificationUnit A
      (Compactification.ofIsProper (𝟙 X)) F a) :
    (rightDerivedLowerShriekIso A (Compactification.ofIsProper (𝟙 X))).symm ≪≫
      c ≪≫ Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso
        (asIso ι ≪≫ lowerStarId (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X) ≪≫
      Functor.mapDerivedCategoryIdIso _ = unboundedEtaleLowerShriekId A X
